text_simplified: Choosing a righteous wife is the foundation of correct tarbiyah (upbringing) for children. A father must choose a woman known for her integrity and righteousness to help him raise the children upon akhlaq (good character) and the religion. A righteous wife supports her husband in the tarbiyah of the children, even if she is not their mother. This choice protects the children from fitnah (trials) and ensures their safety.
